description: Create the included Ubuntu website VM. Its fixed size is 1 CPU, 2 GiB RAM and 10 GiB total disk. No hosting credit is consumed. It is separate from the pilot. If capacity is full, keep the queued operation and original request key; do not create a paid replacement. Wait for an active slot in get_free_resources before commands or SSH. Build apps on this VM with exec_free_resource, then publish_free_website. No paid fallback.

request_key.description: Stable request key. Reuse it after a timeout; never repeat an unknown command with a new key.

name: create_free_website
